## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, the previous behavior, and the new behavior.

## Scope and risk

- [ ] Frontend / backend / schema / deployment changes identified
- [ ] Login, permissions, payment, inventory, commission and refund effects reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, personal inquiry data or production databases included
- [ ] Action SHA, dependency lockfile and install scripts reviewed if changed
- [ ] Catalog remains isolated from real-funds operations

## Evidence

List commands actually run and their results. Mark untested host/chain/cloud checks explicitly.

## Recovery

State migration compatibility, backup requirements and rollback limitations.

## Independent review

For sensitive changes, record the real human reviewer. Do not treat AI output or the PR author's own review as independent approval.
